records.source: If you dig in the dirt you can find some interesting things.#$e#One time I found a really old piece of pottery. I brought it to Gunther and he said it was over a thousand years old.
records.translation: 在泥土裡挖掘，能找到一些有趣的東西。#$e#有一次我發現了一塊非常古老的陶器。我把它拿給岡瑟，他說已有一千多年歷史。

records.source: I shouldn't complain so much about chores... some people in the world are really struggling, and here I am complaining about doing dishes...$s
records.translation: 我不該一直抱怨家務……世上有些人真的過得很艱難，我卻在這裡抱怨洗碗……$s

records.source: Dishes, dishes, dishes. Ugh... If my mother wasn't always nursing a headache from her late nights at the saloon, maybe she could help around the house a little.$s
records.translation: 碗盤、碗盤、又是碗盤。唉……如果媽媽不是總因為在酒館待到深夜而頭痛，也許就能稍微幫忙做點家務。$s

records.source: This is such a small town. You can't avoid meeting everyone.#$e#I wonder what it's like to live in the city?
records.translation: 這個鎮太小了，根本無法避免遇見每個人。#$e#不知道住在城市裡是什麼感覺？

records.source: $d Joja#Things changed a lot after the JojaMart went up. It's been really bad for Pierre's shop. Mom loves JojaMart, though. The prices are cheap, so she can afford a lot more there than she ever could at Pierre's.|Mom's been complaining ever since JojaMart closed down. I think it's good for her, though. Maybe she'll drink less Joja Cola now.
records.translation: $d Joja#Joja 超市開業後，許多事情都變了。這對皮埃爾的店打擊很大。不過媽媽很喜歡 Joja 超市，那裡價格便宜，她買得起的東西比在皮埃爾店裡多得多。|Joja 超市關門後，媽媽一直在抱怨。不過我覺得這對她有好處。也許她現在會少喝一點 Joja 可樂。

records.source: Hello. Ummm...$u#$b#The weather's interesting today, don't you think?#$e#Sorry...$u
records.translation: 你好。嗯……$u#$b#今天天氣很有意思，你不覺得嗎？#$e#抱歉……$u

records.source: I've been trying to keep our place clean, but it always gets messy again.$s#$e#It's hard to run a household all by yourself.$u
records.translation: 我一直努力保持家裡整潔，但總會再次變亂。$s#$e#一個人操持整個家很辛苦。$u

records.source: Oh no?$l#$b#Well, I guess that makes sense... you're busy with other things right now.
records.translation: 喔，不想嗎？$l#$b#好吧，我想也有道理……你現在正忙著其他事情。

records.source: ... Me too. I'm glad you feel that way.$7
records.translation: ……我也是。很高興你有同樣的想法。$7

records.source: Yes... the urge to care for something innocent and helpless. It makes sense that we'd feel that.
records.translation: 是啊……照顧純真又無助生命的衝動。我們會有這種感覺很合理。

records.source: Oh, really?$s#$b# I think you'd make a good parent.$7
records.translation: 喔，真的嗎？$s#$b#我覺得你會成為很好的父母。$7

records.source: hmm...$s#$b#If everyone thought like that, humans would die out.$s
records.translation: 嗯……$s#$b#如果每個人都這麼想，人類就會滅絕。$s

records.source: Oh...$s#$b#That's kind of sad... but I guess I can understand your point.$s
records.translation: 喔……$s#$b#這有點令人難過……但我想自己能理解你的觀點。$s

records.source: Great!$h#$b#Let me just call the children over.
records.translation: 太好了！$h#$b#我這就叫孩子們過來。

records.source: Really?... Uh... Well, alright. I guess I'll see you later then.%fork$s
records.translation: 真的嗎？……呃……好吧。那我晚點再見你。%fork$s

records.source: Thank you...$l#$b#I just wish George wasn't so upset... I was only trying to help.$s
records.translation: 謝謝你……$l#$b#我只希望喬治沒有那麼生氣……我只是想幫忙。$s

records.source: Oh... I guess you're right.$l#$b#I'm sorry, Mr. Mullner. It was rude, what I did.$s
records.translation: 喔……我想你說得對。$l#$b#對不起，穆爾納先生。我的行為很無禮。$s

records.source: I see.
records.translation: 我明白了。

records.source: I guess you're right... why stress out about something you can't change?$u
records.translation: 我想你說得對……何必為無法改變的事情焦慮？$u

records.source: You're right, we shouldn't ignore the reality of aging.$u#$b#I guess the sooner we come to terms with our mortality, the more time we can spend really living in the here-and-now.$u
records.translation: 你說得對，我們不該忽視衰老的現實。$u#$b#我想，越早接受生命終有盡頭，就能花越多時間真正活在當下。$u

records.source: That's nice of you to say... I totally agree with you.#$b#We should treat our elders with the same respect we hope to receive ourselves some day.
records.translation: 你能這麼說真好……我完全同意。#$b#我們應該用自己有一天也希望得到的尊重來對待長輩。

records.source: That's a horrible thing to say. Life is a precious thing to waste like that!$a
records.translation: 這種話太可怕了。生命如此珍貴，不能那樣浪費！$a

records.source: You really mean it? Thank you! ... it's such a relief to hear that.$h#$b#I've been working so hard on this recipe, and I'm really proud of it.
records.translation: 你是真心的嗎？謝謝你！……聽到這句話真讓我鬆了口氣。$h#$b#我為這份食譜付出了很多努力，也真的很自豪。

records.source: Oh... Uh, sure.$s
records.translation: 喔……呃，當然。$s

records.source: Oh...I'm sorry.$s
records.translation: 喔……對不起。$s

records.source: That's right...$8
Really? I thought you'd have noticed by now...$8
records.translation: 真的嗎？我以為你早就注意到了……$8

records.source: No!$9
...Oh, @. I thought you did, but I wasn't sure.$6#$b#...I'll always remember this night.$6^You look so beautiful tonight... I... *gasp*$6
records.translation: ……喔，@。我以為你也喜歡我，但不敢確定。$6#$b#……我會永遠記得今晚。$6^你今晚看起來真美……我……*倒抽一口氣*$6

records.source: Me too.$h
records.translation: 我也是。$h

records.source: ...sorry.$s
records.translation: ……對不起。$s

records.source: I see.$s
records.translation: 我明白了。$s

records.source: Hi... Um, nice weather, isn't it?
records.translation: 嗨……嗯，天氣真好，不是嗎？

records.source: $d cc#Thanks for fixing the community center back up. I guess you're kind of a town hero.|Hello, @. It's nice to see you're doing well.
records.translation: $d cc#謝謝你修復社區中心。我想你算是鎮上的英雄。|你好，@。很高興看到你過得不錯。

records.source: $d bus#I heard you were responsible for fixing the bus back up. Thank you.|My mother used to drive the bus to Calico Desert... but the bus stopped working a few years ago. Mayor says there's not enough money in the town coffers, or else he'd have it fixed.$u
records.translation: $d bus#我聽說是你修好了公車。謝謝你。|媽媽以前會開公車前往卡利科沙漠……但幾年前公車壞了。鎮長說鎮上財政沒有足夠資金，不然早就會把它修好。$u

records.source: So... do you like to decorate your farm house?#$e#It must be nice having your own place to decorate.
records.translation: 所以……你喜歡布置自己的農舍嗎？#$e#能擁有屬於自己的地方來布置一定很好。

records.source: Hello. Ummm...$u#$b#The mountains look nice today, don't they?$u
records.translation: 你好。嗯……$u#$b#今天的山脈看起來很美，不是嗎？$u

records.source: Hi... Um, are you doing okay?$u
records.translation: 嗨……嗯，你還好嗎？$u

records.source: It's kind of embarrassing to be the only family in town who lives in a trailer.$u#$e#I wish I could live in a nice house, someday.$s
records.translation: 我們是鎮上唯一住在拖車屋裡的家庭，讓我有點難為情。$u#$e#希望有一天我能住進漂亮的房子。$s

records.source: Your farm looks really pretty right now.$h
records.translation: 你的農場現在看起來真美。$h

records.source: Mom doesn't take very good care of herself...$u#$e#I worry about her.$u
records.translation: 媽媽不太會照顧自己……$u#$e#我很擔心她。$u

records.source: Fall is a sad time of year for me...$s
records.translation: 秋天對我來說是一年中悲傷的時節……$s

records.source: When I was a little girl, my father abandoned us because he said he felt 'trapped'. We haven't seen him since.$s#$b#I'm sorry to make things uncomfortable for you... It's just that this time of year makes me think of it for some reason.$u#$e#Anyway... How's the farming life going?
records.translation: 我小時候，父親拋棄了我們，因為他說自己感到「受困」。從那以後，我們再也沒見過他。$s#$b#抱歉讓你覺得不自在……只是每年到這個時候，我總會莫名想起這件事。$u#$e#不管怎樣……農場生活過得如何？

records.source: @! I was just thinking about the future...#$e#Where do you picture yourself in ten years?$l#$e#I have a few ideas for myself...$u
records.translation: @！我剛才正在思考未來……#$e#你想像自己十年後會在哪裡？$l#$e#我對自己的未來有幾個想法……$u

records.source: Hi @.$h#$e#Your farmhouse must be pretty easy to clean, huh?
records.translation: 嗨，@。$h#$e#你的農舍一定很容易打掃，對吧？

records.source: ...yes?$u
records.translation: ……有事嗎？$u

records.source: Are you friends with Linus? He lives in a tent up in the mountains.#$e#Everyone ignores him, the poor guy. He's actually really nice... Just a little odd.#$e#It must be so cold to live in a tent this time of year.
records.translation: 你和萊納斯是朋友嗎？他住在山上的帳篷裡。#$e#所有人都忽視他，真可憐。其實他人很好……只是有點古怪。#$e#這個時節住在帳篷裡一定非常冷。

records.source: I'm looking forward to seeing what your farm looks like in the spring.#$e#It's going to be so fresh and beautiful.$h
records.translation: 我很期待看到你的農場在春天會是什麼模樣。#$e#一定會清新又美麗。$h

records.source: I try to stay indoors as much as possible during the winter. I hate being cold.
records.translation: 冬天我會盡量待在室內。我討厭寒冷。

records.source: Oh... hi. You want to talk?$u#$e#If you find any interesting artifacts or minerals, Gunther will gladly display them in the museum.#$e#He told me he has special gifts for people who donate.
records.translation: 喔……嗨。你想聊聊嗎？$u#$e#如果你找到有趣的古物或礦物，岡瑟會很樂意在博物館裡展示。#$e#他告訴我，會送特別禮物給捐贈的人。

records.source: On the 25th we'll be having the Feast of the Winter Star. It's one of my favorite events.#$e#It's supposed to be a time to show gratitude for all the good things in your life... but for most people it's just a time to relax and exchange gifts.
records.translation: 25 日我們會舉辦冬日星盛宴。那是我最喜歡的活動之一。#$e#這本應是感謝生命中所有美好事物的時刻……但對多數人來說，只是放鬆和交換禮物的日子。
